result.title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
result.summary: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出现有 MLLM 缺乏多视角融合与视角变换能力，提出用一小组 spatial tokens 在模型内部承载融合后的 3D 场景，并通过监督使其在推理时按视角重新表达，配合探针检验两项能力及推理速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关联 LVR 中「几何与任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态」：其空间 token workspace、重表达监督及撤除 token 后的能力残留，可供核查 latent 表示是否真正承载并参与推理。
